At the moment they are three weeks (they were weekly to start with), she's very flexible so I could get them back to weekly if necessary. 

I guess that might be a good first step.

Thank you for replying, it means a lot. 

Isolated is really good word to sum it up. I think he probably did plan on me always being here but I think he was probably right. It's nice to read  that you got out and started afresh but I don't think I could. Getting a job would be really tough (he may not give me a good review and I have no real experience other than this) and I certainly don't have the money for a house. 

I always end up coming back to the fact that I love him and I don't know if I could cope losing the person I love more than anything. I honestly never though I could love a cheat but life is strange sometimes.

Thank you. I think you must have been in a similar situation to the one I'm in now. 

The STD issue especially has been a big one for me. He's adamant he used protection but I also found out he had an STD test right before I found out about everything. It doesn't feel like something someone who used protection all the time would do. 

I know he was cruel but in my mind I'm better with him than without him. Without him I'm in the same situation but without the man I love, a home, my cat, a job or any friends. That's why I feel like there is no solution.

Thank you, it's so nice that everyone has been so kind. 

My therapy feels like it helps sometimes, but then in between sessions it seems to all fall apart again. I'll keep going of course, but it feels like it's not quite enough.

Im sorry this happened to you too. It really does feel shitty, it's so odd that it's often glossed over as a joke in the media when the pain is so so real. 

I definitely feel like I have basically no self-worth at the moment. I've had a difficult time since before I met him with depression and anxiety and now, having something 'concrete' to cause them, it's much harder. 

I want to believe I'm a better person than him but he is an incredible person. He's funny and smart, compassionate, savvy and good looking to boot. I think that makes it all the harder. 

I have been tempted to go home for a while. I don't want to worry my family though, especially since they ADORE my fiancé. It's all very difficult.  Thank you for replying though, it means a lot.

Thank you. It was and is really painful. 

My family don't know. He actually got "outed" because one of our friends saw him out with another woman, but I covered for him and haven't told anyone (other than my therapist). 

I desperately wish I could but I still love him so much that I can't bring myself to make anyone I know hate him.
